scope: owned binding construction fused with initial sums
defaults: Only independently measured improvements qualify for production; inconclusive or regressing choices stay experimental.
protocol: No new protocol/version/security changes; complete proof equality required.
timing: Three seeds and 21 untraced samples per configuration for both cold and repeated proofs; separate diagnostic profiles; no concurrent build or test work during measured runs.
memory_note: Retained L4 costs 32 MiB for Falcon-512 and 64 MiB for Falcon-1024 at batch 1024 because TwoLimbs adds one row bit.
trace_note: Ignore the legacy BITZ_TRACE MB-faulted field: it assumes 16 KiB pages, but actual host pages are 4 KiB. Use benchmark getrusage counts and RSS.
unused_build_note: candidate-v1 compiled before private bucket storage hardening; it is not used for measurements. candidate-v2 contains the reviewed final experiment source.

decision.reason: Only PCS task sizing showed a consistent independent benefit. Forest-wide and retained-L4 regressed; binding fusion was inconclusive and inactive at the legacy 12-worker selector.

nonqualification_phases: profiles and standalone baseline-profiles are diagnostic; smoke and correctness phases only validate correctness.
